Leo Bianchi  
Data Scientist | AdVantage Technologies  
Email: leo.bianchi@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/leobianchi | GitHub: github.com/leobianchi  

Professional Experience / Work History  
At TargetX Media (2021–present), I led the development of a real-time recommendation engine that increased user engagement by 32% across their ad-serving platform. This system, built using Python and Pandas, processed 10 million+ user interactions daily, with NumPy enabling efficient matrix operations for personalized targeting. I also optimized SQL analytics pipelines, reducing query latency by 40% through index restructuring and partitioning strategies, which supported cross-team initiatives in audience segmentation.  

Previously, as a Data Scientist at AdTech Innovations (2019–2021), I designed a REST API for campaign performance tracking, integrating with their ad server to provide real-time metrics. This tool reduced manual reporting time by 50% for client teams. My work with Pandas and NumPy streamlined data preprocessing for machine learning models, contributing to a 25% improvement in ad click-through rates for high-value campaigns.  

In my early role as a Data Analyst at Marketing Insights Group (2018), I built predictive models for customer retention, leveraging SQL to aggregate and analyze 50 million+ records. These insights informed targeted marketing strategies that boosted campaign efficiency by 18%.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed a recommendation system for a retail client using collaborative filtering, achieving a 28% increase in user conversion rates. The project, implemented in Python with Pandas for data manipulation and NumPy for matrix computations, demonstrated the scalability of algorithmic approaches in real-world scenarios.  

Created a side project to refactor legacy SQL queries for a nonprofit organization, reducing execution time by 60% and enabling faster data-driven decision-making. This work involved designing a distributed architecture using Spark, though the tool’s role was minimal compared to Python-based solutions.  

Built a REST API for internal data integration, allowing seamless transfer of campaign metrics between ad servers and analytics platforms. The API, developed using Python’s Flask framework, reduced data reconciliation errors by 75% and improved cross-team collaboration.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Python: Core to my workflow, used for data cleaning, model prototyping, and automation scripts. Pandas and NumPy underpin most analytical tasks, from feature engineering to large-scale data transformation.  

SQL analytics: Architectural decisions in query optimization, such as partitioning and indexing, have significantly improved data retrieval performance. Mentored junior engineers on best practices for writing scalable SQL queries.  

Recommendation systems: Designed and deployed collaborative filtering models that drive personalized ad targeting. Ownership of these systems includes iterative improvements based on A/B testing and user feedback.  

REST API design: Integral to data integration workflows, with a focus on ensuring compatibility between ad-tech platforms and analytics tools.  

Pandas: Central to data manipulation, with extensive use in preprocessing for machine learning pipelines. Custom functions developed in Pandas have streamlined data workflows across multiple projects.  

NumPy: Critical for numerical computations, particularly in matrix operations for recommendation algorithms. Its efficiency has been pivotal in handling high-dimensional data at scale.  

Apache Spark: Occasionally used for distributed processing, though Python-based solutions have been more effective for the specific use cases I’ve encountered.  

Education  
Master of Science in Data Science, University of California, Berkeley (2019)  

Certifications  
Google Professional Data Engineer (2022)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as “Top Contributor” at TargetX Media for optimizing SQL pipelines that reduced query latency by 40%. Published a paper on recommendation system scalability at the 2023 AdTech Conference, highlighting Python-based approaches for real-time personalization.
